maria_cs: Quick sync: were running a lightweight priming + feedback flow for OrionFin Monday 09:00 PT. Goal: reduce first-100 requests errors, collect targeted failure examples, and flag renewal risk early.

rahul_csm: Proposed runbook (short):
- T-30m: spin warmpool (orion-warm) target 2, ramp 0->2 over 10m.
- T-15m: prefill 6 short sequences, cache policy=prefix, vary user ids. Keep sequences <120 tokens.
- T+0..60m: monitor error-rate, latency P95, and tool-call failures.
- T+24h: 24h CSAT + capture top 5 failure prompts.

olivia_tse: Add eval set of 8 prompts that exercise slot-fill, redaction, and a tool call. If semantic failure >= 4% on eval, tag "escalate:product". Also record whether fallback routing occurred.

maria_cs: Prefill payload example pls? Ill run from my laptop.

ops-bot: Prefill template:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.redwood-inference/v1/prefill \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"tenant":"orionfin","sequences":[{"prompt":"welcome_1","count":2},{"prompt":"slot_test","count":4}],"cache":"prefix","target_pool":"orion-warm"}'
```

rahul_csm: Fallbacks: route_policy -> latency-first -> model: small-quantized-v1 if latency P95 >300ms for 5m, and scale warmpool to 0 if cost spike >50% above forecast.

olivia_tse: Renewal risk signals: CSAT <=5 at 24h OR unique failing prompts >3 OR semantic failures on eval >=4%. Tag tenant "renewal-risk" and schedule AM touch within 48h.

maria_cs: I'll post coachmark copy + feedback form link here after prefill. Running prefill at 08:30 PT tomorrow.

ops-bot: Warmpool scheduled: id=wp-orion-176111, start=2024-11-18T16:30:00Z, target=2, ramp_minutes=10. Prefill job queued: id=pf-1761112222.

maria_cs: Thanks all 94e. Will report results and any escalations in this thread.
